contrastDeclaredBeforeEvaluation: At fixed checkpoints14 and15, remove only the constant zero-state logit: sigmoid(z(s)-z(0)); compare new-minus-old checkpoint performance under centering versus original. This contrast was chosen using an earlier independent cohort, before this holdout centering evaluation.
intervention: Inference-time subtraction of the logit at state [0,0,0,0]; all weights and training history held fixed. This is a controller intervention, not further training.
